name: Saturn
description: Ringed planets tilted every way, the near side of each ring crossing in front of the globe and the far side tucked behind it.

code.style: --rule: ( --t: @r(-32deg, 32deg); --s: @r(0.72, 1.06); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 46% 15% at 50% 50%, transparent 70%, #000 70% 100%, transparent 100%); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 46% 15% at 50% 50%, transparent 70%, #000 70% 100%, transparent 100%); transform: rotate(@var(--t)) scale(@var(--s)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 26%; z-index: 2; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 95.83% 31.25% at 50% 50%, #000 70%, transparent 70% 100%, #000 100%), linear-gradient(#000 50%, transparent 50%); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 95.83% 31.25% at 50% 50%, #000 70%, transparent 70% 100%, #000 100%), linear-gradient(#000 50%, transparent 50%); transform: rotate(@var(--t)) scale(@var(--s)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
